name: Your Company
tagline: Wrought iron made to be handed down
niche: Art forging: railings, staircases, balconies, gates and metal décor

listing.description: A website for a forge or art-forging workshop. The railing on the first screen draws itself scroll by scroll, every catalogue item has its own forged mark, and projects sit in arched frames.

seo.title: Your Company — art forging and wrought iron in Tashkent
seo.description: Wrought iron railings, staircases, balconies and gates made to your sketch. Hand forging, powder coating and turnkey installation across Tashkent.
seo.answer: Your Company is an art-forging workshop at 18 Chupon-ota Street, Tashkent. Wrought iron railings start at 1,200,000 sum per metre, balconies at 1,500,000 sum per metre and gates at 9,000,000 sum. Measuring and the sketch are free, production takes from 3 weeks, and welding and paint carry a 5-year guarantee.

sections.title: Iron turned into lace
sections.subtitle: Railings, staircases, balconies and gates to your sketch. Every scroll is hand-forged at the fire and fitted on site.

sections.label: Workshop
sections.title: A forge, not a factory
sections.text: We do not stamp parts out of a catalogue. Every leaf, volute and spear is forged by our smiths from bar and rod, at the fire and on the anvil. That is why a railing follows the curve of your stair and a gate echoes the pattern of the façade.

sections.label: What we make
sections.title: What we forge
sections.intro: Prices include powder coating and exclude installation. We give the exact figure after measuring and a sketch.

items.title: Measuring
items.text: A master visits with metal and patina samples, takes measurements and we talk through the style.

items.title: Sketch and estimate
items.text: We draw two or three options to scale and work out an exact price. You only pay if you like it.

items.title: Forging
items.text: We forge the parts by hand, assemble the piece on the bench and send you photos and video.

items.title: Finishing
items.text: Blasting, primer, powder coat and patina, so the iron stays rust-free for years.

items.title: Installation
items.text: We install in a day, leave the site clean and hand over the guarantee.

items.quote: The railing came out exactly as sketched. The master suggested an oak handrail himself, and now it is the highlight of the house.
items.author: Dilnoza

items.quote: We ordered gates and 40 metres of fence. They delivered and installed in two days, all level and with no weld marks.
items.author: Sherzod

items.quote: They restored the balconies of an old building from photographs and matched the pattern down to the last scroll.
items.author: Anna

items.q: How much do wrought iron railings cost?
items.a: From 1,200,000 sum per metre including paint. The price rises with the density of the ornament and the thickness of the bar; we give the exact figure after the sketch.
Yes, measuring and the sketch are free within Tashkent. Outside the city it is 150,000 sum, deducted from the order.
Railings and balconies take 3–4 weeks, gates 4–6 and staircases 5–7 weeks from sketch approval.
Before painting we blast and prime the metal, then apply powder coat. The finish carries a 5-year guarantee.

items.q: Can I order from my own picture?
items.a: Of course. Send a photo or drawing on Telegram and we will turn it into a drawing and suggest how to adapt it to your dimensions.
